rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for addressing or describing someone dearly loved.

example.jyutping: can1 oi3 ge3 nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing someone or something as specially cherished or treasured rather than as a form of address.

example.english: This necklace is my most beloved treasure.
example.traditional: 呢條頸鏈係我最心愛嘅寶物。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 geng2 lin6 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 sam1 oi3 ge3 bou2 mat6
